description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Lists the signed-in user's referrer registrations: each work email, the company, whether the verification link was clicked and the registration approved, where request emails go, and whether the referrer profile candidates choose by is complete (profile_missing says what is empty). Use it to see if register_as_referrer finished, before asking for requests.
name: list_referrer_registrations

can_receive_requests.description: Verified, email confirmed and linked to a company: requests reach this registration.

email_mode.description: instant = one email per request; daily = one summary at 09:00 ICT.

email_verified.description: True once the user clicked the link emailed to the work email.

id.description: Registration id; pass it to set_referrer_email_notifications.

max_open_claims.description: Requests the user may hold (taken, not finished) at once.

notify_to_account.description: Request emails go to the techjobs.vn account email instead of the work email.

paused.description: While paused, candidates do not see this referrer and no new requests arrive.

profile.description: The anonymous referrer profile candidates see when they choose referrers; no name or email is shown.

profile_complete.description: True once title, team, level and at least one area are all set; the Referrer profile tab shows a tick for this.

profile_missing.description: What is still empty in the referrer profile; update_referrer_profile sets it. Empty when profile_complete.

title: List my referrer registrations
